Import.title: Import workout data
Import.intro: Bring your training history from another app. Hevy and Strong CSV exports are supported.

hevy.title: Hevy
hevy.hint: Hevy app -> Profile -> Export & Import Data -> Export Workouts

errors.unknown_error: Import failed. Please check the file and try again.

unsupported.title: Unsupported sources
unsupported.myfitnesspal: MyFitnessPal: the official CSV format could not be reliably verified, so it isn't supported yet.
unsupported.yazio: Yazio: doesn't officially offer a CSV export (PDF only, or a GDPR data request) -- so it isn't supported.
unsupported.wearables: Apple Health, Google Fit, Garmin, Fitbit, Withings, Polar, and Strava need OAuth or native app access and are planned for a later version.
